coordinate_system.units: Unity units; player mesh is 10.8 u tall, so 1 unit ~= 0.18 m in-game
coordinate_system.bake: source Max Z-up meshes rotated by M=[[-1,0,0],[0,0,1],[0,1,0]] into Y-up, then rotY(bake_rotation_y_deg), then translated so min Y = 0 and the XZ bounding box is centred on the origin
coordinate_system.texture_uv: raw Unity UVs (origin bottom-left, V NOT flipped)

findings.note: No road/floor/straight-road-tile/junction mesh exists anywhere in the APK (160 meshes total, all listed in the report). The endless track surface is generated by game code; only wall, gate, rock and tree meshes are shipped.

verified_layout.description: six exported OBJ assembled into a 30 u wide straight corridor on a procedurally generated road plane; renders correctly from a Temple-Run-like chase camera
verified_layout.material_recipe: MeshLambertMaterial({ map: wallTexture.png, side: THREE.DoubleSide }); textures: THREE.TextureLoader defaults (flipY = true), colorSpace = SRGBColorSpace

source.bundle_note: every Mesh ships in its own single-object AssetBundle, so path_id is 1 and the bundle GUID is the file name

uv.three_note: load textures with THREE.TextureLoader defaults (flipY = true) and use the OBJ vt values unchanged

files.face_note: plane coordinates of the biggest axis-aligned faces, for placement math. Their sign is NOT reliable as a facing direction: the source meshes have mixed/inverted winding (see report). Decide which side is decorated by looking at preview.html - the decorated side shows the gold trim band and crenellations, the back is a rough mossy slope.
files.placement: Long straight crenellated wall with gold trim band: 60.17 u along +Z, 36.78 u tall, 24.07 u deep. VERIFIED placement (preview.html?cam=run, corridor half width 15): left wall rotation.y = PI at x = -(halfWidth + 11.36); right wall rotation.y = 0 at x = +(halfWidth + 11.36); y = 0; z = tile centre; repeat every 60.17 along +Z. The decorated side is the one showing the gold band + crenellations; if a wall shows a rough mossy slope instead, it is 180 deg round.

files.placement: 90-degree L corner of the same wall: two decorated faces meeting at a right angle inside a 50.0 x 50.0 footprint, 36.8 u tall. The L walls hug two adjacent edges of the bounding box and face into the box, so the enclosed (track) side is the quadrant between them; the four 90-degree rotations cover all four turn directions. Place it so the two decorated faces line up with the straight wall faces of the two legs. Only the concave arrangement is possible from this mesh (a convex/outside wrap would need a mirrored copy).
